scope.pasc_note: PASC is included as an evidence-reviewed six-component aggregate. Its calculations match R; named sensitivity ranges retain scientific uncertainty that is not represented as a confidence interval.

configuration.aging_of_mortality_and_life_expectancy_a: FALSE; adult-population-weighted values are held constant
configuration.reporting_unit: cumulative five-year DALYs per person and per 1,000 adults
